item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery support for zonal disaster recovery for Ultra disks
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports Zone-to-Zone Disaster Recovery for Azure Ultra disks. This lets customers replicate and recover performance-intensive virtual machines across Availability Zones to handle zonal disruptions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone resilience for Azure VMs
item.description:
Zone resilience for Azure VMs is in public preview. It allows an eligible zonal VM to be recovered in another availability zone within the same region while keeping the existing VM resource and configuration, with ZRS managed disks used for synchronous cross-zone replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager
item.description:
Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager is now generally available. It provides a unified, goal-driven way to improve application resiliency across Azure, including zonally resilient deployment templates and application assessment capabilities.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Availabile: Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets is generally available. It continuously monitors scale sets across availability zones and redistributes VM instances when zonal imbalances are detected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Azure has introduced a public preview of Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Azure will automatically choose suitable availability zones based on SKU availability, capacity, and placement requirements, reducing the need to manage zone lists manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates
